name: Johor Bahru
tagline: Theme parks and food across the strait from Singapore
summary: Johor Bahru sits just across the causeway from Singapore. Visit the hilltop Sultan Abu Bakar Mosque, wander the heritage streets and temples of the old town, take the family to Legoland Malaysia, and eat cheaply at the city's hawker centres.
seasonNote: Hot and humid all year; heavier rain from November to January.
arrival: Buses and the shuttle train cross from Singapore (traffic can be heavy at the causeway); flights to Senai airport.
cashTip: Cards and e-wallets work widely; carry cash for hawker stalls. No tipping.
foodTip: Laksa Johor, mee rebus, otak-otak and durian.
buyTip: Outlet shopping at Johor Premium Outlets.

connections.note: Causeway buses or the shuttle train.
